Get the Guide Download our How to Measure Guide to review a step by step example project using all GenStone panels and accessories. FAQs Ask Away. We’ve Heard It All. What colors are in Stratford stone panels? Stratford features a sophisticated blend of slate gray, rose, beige, and earth-tone accents. The balanced color palette creates a timeless look that works with both traditional and transitional home styles. What style of home works best with Stratford? Stratford is especially popular on traditional homes, craftsman-style homes, transitional designs, fireplaces and feature walls, and exterior accents and entryways. Its combination of cool and warm tones makes it one of GenStone’s most versatile colors. Is Stratford a warm or cool color? Stratford sits comfortably between warm and cool. Its slate gray foundation provides sophistication, while subtle rose and beige highlights add warmth and depth. Does Stratford look like natural stone? Yes. Customers frequently mention how realistic Stratford looks once installed. Its natural color variation and authentic texture are designed to replicate the appearance of traditional stone masonry. Is Stratford easy to install? Yes. Stratford panels are lightweight and designed for straightforward installation using basic tools. Many customers report completing projects in a fraction of the time required for traditional stone installations. What do I need to complete a Stratford project? Most Stratford projects use Full Panels, Inside and Outside Corners, Trim, Ledgers, and Caps and Pillar Components. These pieces work together as part of the GenStone Stacked Stone System to create a finished, professional appearance. Can Stratford be used indoors and outdoors? Yes. Stratford is suitable for fireplaces, accent walls, exterior facades, outdoor kitchens, entryways, and many other residential and commercial applications.
